item.title: Agentic Infrastructure
item.summary: 企业 Agentic Infrastructure 的控制权不在模型 API 或 Agent 数量，而在谁能把 Memory、Skill、Tool Runtime、身份授权、隔离、调度、观测、评估与成本账本组合成可恢复、可审计、可复算的成功任务。AWS、Google、Microsoft、Anthropic、Databricks 与 Snowflake 已分别从云运行时、工作入口、开放协议、数据治理和 ML 运维切入；生产案例已证明局部价值，但跨平台成功任务率、30/90 日留存、事故全成本和同口径单位经济仍未知，因此阶段只能判 pilot。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来 12–36 个月，开放协议会降低工具接入成本，但价值将向掌握企业身份、运行隔离、状态恢复、工具策略、持续评估和成本归因的平台集中。若厂商不能把每次尝试连接到成功任务、人工接管、事故与续费，能力清单不会自动形成可持续的生产控制层。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 企业 Agentic Infrastructure 的控制权不在模型 API 或 Agent 数量，而在谁能把 Memory、Skill、Tool Runtime、身份授权、隔离、调度、观测、评估与成本账本组合成可恢复、可审计、可复算的成功任务。AWS、Google、Microsoft、Anthropic、Databricks 与 Snowflake 已分别从云运行时、工作入口、开放协议、数据治理和 ML 运维切入；生产案例已证明局部价值，但跨平台成功任务率、30/90 日留存、事故全成本和同口径单位经济仍未知，因此阶段只能判 pilot。
synthesis.why_now: MCP 已跨主要平台，Memory、Session、Identity、Gateway、Tracing 和 Evaluation 开始成为独立 SKU；Microsoft 客户案例出现任务结果，同时 Snowflake 的官方限制、MCP/Skill 安全研究和 MIT 透明度审计显示端到端治理仍未闭合。
winner_conditions: Memory 可版本化、可删除、可回滚，并与权限和数据保留策略一致
Skill 与 Tool 带来源、版本、能力证明、最小权限和撤销机制
Runtime 支持会话隔离、长任务、暂停恢复、幂等和失败补偿
身份授权按用户、工具、动作、数据范围和时效细分
Tracing、evaluation、业务结果和成本使用同一 run/task identity
平台公开每成功任务全成本、人工接管率、事故率和 30/90 日留存

evidence.source_quote: The evaluation and monitoring component of MLflow 3 is designed to help you iteratively optimize the quality of your GenAI app. Evaluation and monitoring build upon MLflow Tracing , which provides real-time trace logging in the development, testing, and production phases. Traces can be evaluated during development using built-in or custom LLM judges and scorers , and production monitoring can reuse the same judges and scorers, ensuring consistent evaluation throughout the application lifecycle. Domain experts can provide feedback using an integrated Review App for collecting human feedback, producing evaluation data for further iteration.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Databricks/MLflow 把开发评估、Tracing 和生产监控统一，代表数据平台从知识底座进入 Agent 运维控制面。

evidence.source_quote: Ground truth staleness: Depending on how you word your input queries, results may drift over time. Agents with MCP connectors: Evaluations are not currently supported for agents that have an MCP connector.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Snowflake 官方限制显示 MCP 连接器尚不能进入同一评估闭环，反证了“托管平台已覆盖端到端治理”。

evidence.source_quote: This involves loading the Linux kernel's "act_pedit" Traffic Control (tc) packet editing subsystem into an unprivileged user namespace and exploiting CVE-2026-46331 in the guest kernel, a recently disclosed flaw called pedit COW, to obtain guest-root. From there, the agent can access the whole host ("/") with elevated privileges, allowing it to read or write files from and to the Mac's file system as the logged-in desktop user.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 专业安全媒体对 Agent 沙箱逃逸/权限风险的报道只作反证线索，不作为厂商事实或事故统计。

evidence.source_quote: Cortex Agents is a fully managed agentic platform for building and running AI agents within Snowflake’s governed environment. An agent reasons over a request, plans the work, calls tools, executes code, and generates a response, without requiring you to build or operate your own orchestration loop, runtime, or sandbox infrastructure. Data access is governed by Snowflake privileges and the execution context of each configured tool.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Snowflake Cortex Agents 将编排、代码沙箱、权限和数据工具绑定到受治理数据环境，代表 data-control-plane archetype。

evidence.source_quote: There are now more than 10,000 active public MCP servers, covering everything from developer tools to Fortune 500 deployments; MCP has been adopted by ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Visual Studio Code, and other popular AI products. Claude now has a directory with over 75 connectors.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MCP 的跨平台采用、Registry、异步操作、无状态和服务器身份说明 Tool Runtime 正形成开放接口层。

evidence.source_quote: Runtime Active Consumption Based CPU Memory $0.0895 per vCPU-hour $0.00945 per GB-hour. Gateway API Invocations $0.005 per 1,000 invocations. Identity Token or API key requests for non-AWS resources $0.010 per 1,000 token or API keys requested by the agent.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AgentCore 官方价格揭示 Agentic Infra 的计费单位与成本归因：活跃 CPU、峰值内存、Gateway、Identity、Memory 和 Observability。

evidence.source_quote: The multi-year, $200 million agreement will not only make Anthropic’s Claude models available in the Snowflake platform to more than 12,600 global customers across Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Microsoft Azure. Thousands of Snowflake customers already process trillions of Claude tokens per month.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Snowflake/Anthropic 披露 Intercom 等客户的生产 Agent、跨云模型和受治理数据闭环；指标均保留厂商联合披露边界。

evidence.source_quote: The updated web agent has performed dramatically better than the original with up to 61% lower latency and up to 70% fewer human escalations. Customers who engage with the new web agent are ten times more likely to move forward signing up for services.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft 自身生产案例展示工作入口、多 Agent 编排、治理和客户体验结果，但仍按厂商自述边界使用。
